title: Normalized coherent scalar quotient realization on an arbitrary scheme
statement: Fix a prime ell, finite extensions E,L of Q_ell and an embedding i:E -> L. For every scheme X, every whole-system derived reduction calculus S for E on X [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus] and every K-injective-normalized Roos model rho for L on X, there exists an IntegralComparisonScalarModel for i,X,S,rho [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Its natural realization identifies completed scalar extension with whole-system scalar change of S.reduction followed by total derived limit, and has the specified balanced tensor-generator normalization on every whole-system adjunction-coherent quotient presentation of each flat-term K-flat representative. No invertibility hypothesis on ell on X, constructibility, completeness or Tor-amplitude hypothesis is imposed. Site and coefficient universes are independent. This states a single-scheme primitive scalar comparison only, without pullback data, effectivity, simultaneous choices or coherence laws.

theorem ambientQuotientScalarModel_exists (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L) (X : Scheme.{t})
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (ρ : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l L X) :
    Nonempty (IntegralComparisonScalarModel l E L ι X S ρ)
